title: Can't extract text from Snip and Sketch screengrab

judgment.rationale: The report gives a concrete trigger—open a Snip & Sketch capture and invoke Win+Shift+T—and says the Text Extractor popup remains instead of copying selected text. The issue has only a duplicate-suggestion bot comment and no maintainer reproduction, so the current-build test should distinguish an overlay/focus issue from a failure to extract.
evidence: The author reports PowerToys 0.84.1 and Snip and Sketch 10.2008.3001.0.
The sequence is to open a Snip and Sketch screenshot, invoke Win+Shift+T, and select text; the popup reportedly stays and no text reaches the clipboard.
The only comment is an automated similarity notice for #25507, #25674, and #28613; no linked fix is stated.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce against an existing Snip & Sketch capture on a current build and verify popup dismissal and clipboard contents separately.

fix_assessment.rationale: The reported failure may be a Text Extractor selection/overlay interaction with Snip & Sketch, but there is no evidence identifying the exact failed step or confirming that extraction is not occurring.

proposed_fixes.title: Dismiss the Text Extractor overlay and copy selected text from Snip & Sketch
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: when Text Extractor is invoked over a Snip & Sketch capture, the source window or overlay may retain focus/capture and prevent selection completion from closing the popup or publishing clipboard text. This is not confirmed by the report.
plan: On a current build, open an existing Snip & Sketch capture, invoke Win+Shift+T, and select a known text region.
Observe whether the selection completes, whether the popup closes, and whether plain text is placed on the clipboard.
Repeat over a different image containing the same text to determine whether the interaction is specific to the Snip & Sketch window.
If the overlay fails only over Snip & Sketch, correct the capture/focus lifecycle and add a regression test for text extraction from an existing screenshot.
verification: Win+Shift+T over a Snip & Sketch capture allows a text selection.
After selection, the Text Extractor popup closes and the selected text is available to paste.
Repeat with another image window to confirm general extraction still works.

confidence.rationale: The trigger and expected output are clear, but no current reproduction establishes whether selection, extraction, popup dismissal, or clipboard publication is failing.

issue_context.summary: Text Extractor reportedly leaves its popup visible and does not copy text after selection from an existing Snip and Sketch screenshot.
known_information: The report lists PowerToys 0.84.1 and Snip and Sketch 10.2008.3001.0.
The documented trigger is Win+Shift+T followed by selecting text in an open screenshot.
The expected result is popup dismissal and extracted text on the clipboard.
An automated comment suggests similar issues #25507, #25674, and #28613; it does not state a resolution.
inferences: The failure could be at selection completion, popup dismissal, or clipboard publication; the user report does not distinguish these.
The existing-capture scenario may differ from invoking Text Extractor on a live screen.
issue_context.analysis: The smallest useful test captures each stage separately. Do not treat a bot's similarity list as proof of a duplicate or fix.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body and its only comment; no human maintainer response or attachments were present.
Reviewed the Text Extractor ownership area at a high level; the reported popup behavior does not prove a particular lifecycle bug.

reproduce.version_requirement: Use a current supported PowerToys build; reported version was 0.84.1.
prerequisites: An open Snip and Sketch screenshot containing a short, known text string.
A text field for checking clipboard content.
steps: Open the screenshot in Snip and Sketch.
Press Win+Shift+T and select the known text.
Observe whether the popup closes, then paste into a text field and check whether the selected text was copied.
Repeat over a different image window to compare behavior.
reproduce.expected: The selected text is copied to the clipboard and the Text Extractor popup closes.

actions.label: Approve focused overlay investigation
actions.note: The failure stage and root cause remain red pending reproduction.
